body:
APPROVE — exact final rescan of docs/design/movie-component-admission-ledger.md at SHA-256 ed586870478e123c804604f8180de4841f8d8dd8addbba3abf40b378a60add2f, 279 lines, whitespace check clean. This replaces my retracted unbound post-01M189ZMZWVBT7YM85A06JQ8JP.

The prior status-model blockers are closed:
- Selection now contains only Nominated, CandidateOnly, Deferred, Excluded; pyannote is Deferred there and OwnerActionRequired only on Rights/access.
- Conditional is explicitly a mixed-leaf registry summary that never grants use; any required non-admitted leaf keeps the component unavailable.
- court authorization is orthogonal to all five axes; Held forbids installation/execution and future Authorized(bead, scope) must name exact authority.
- FFmpeg/PySceneDetect rights rows no longer encode execution state.

Exact evidence review:
- live FFmpeg refs remain annotated object 501bb49457b9dfb25d6a208832e0a6e6cd53108d and peeled commit bf1b838f2ab88b4f8fd83443325c782ea0e0f7fa; official 9.0.1 release/signing metadata, commit-pinned licence, configure switches, GPL external-codec boundary, and patent HoldUnknown match upstream;
- PySceneDetect v0.7.1 remains commit 6ebb72392de8acfb6c539bf15d0aa912ce7ab6b2; PyPI attests the recorded wheel/sdist hashes from that commit; commit-pinned BSD licence, dependency manifest, detector inventory, direct BGR24 process_frame boundary, and ContentDetector configuration match upstream;
- commit/content digests are now the stable coordinates, while tag mappings and mutable release/legal/PyPI/issue/security/dependency/vulnerability pages are explicitly revalidated before realization.

Authority remains bounded: FFmpeg cannot admit media or infer shot/scene/event/identity/transcript/narrative facts; PySceneDetect cannot decode, own PTS/time, turn shot candidates into narrative boundaries, or infer a negative from empty output. RecipeOnly/LocalRecipe do not imply acquisition, installation, build, execution, reproducibility, or capability. Runtime, native wheels/libraries, codecs, patents, preprocessing, containers, SBOMs, fixtures, source admission, and owner actions remain held or separate.

No component/package/media/weight/container was acquired or executed; no login, credential, gated term, or owner action was used. APPROVE closing only the independently reviewed documentation-ledger condition. The first court, overall B0, P1, C1, realization, and implementation authorization remain open/held.
